route: cheap Lowlevel PrintWindow on hidden desktop MFEInstalledProof3, installed v1.657.1, isolated profile
notes: All frames are 1920x1200 PNG of a 1280x800 DIP window; the 1.0 states are as the installed app rendered them.
privatePathVisible=true frames show the scratch vault folder path (full or truncated); keep them private.
Missing by design: 22-force-lock-dialog dark/bilingual and 21-lock-holder-message light/dark bilingual (holder process had expired; those frames were discarded).
Home and New tab popover are tall pages captured at the top only; the popover is clipped by the 800 px window.
The Updates page in later frames shows the app auto-staged update 1.671.1 from the public feed; it was never applied.
